6872.title: Provider preview prematurely commits handoff state
6872.rootCauseOneLine: The provider preview helper commits parent handoff state before any model selection; Escape clears only local browsing state.

prReviews.verdict: Addresses root cause (static review; closed, unmerged)
prReviews.topFinding: Same minimal callback-boundary repair; branch not executed.

6872.proposedFix: Invoke onStart only from the explicit handoff action, leaving provider browsing local and model commits on the existing onSelect path.
6872.caveats: Component and browser callback reproduction, not a live paid provider turn. Full app suite had one unrelated cold-load timing failure that passed on targeted rerun.
